**Finding: LICENSE — compliant (at the preferred position).** No redline proposed.

- **§ 13.1** grants the subscription right to *Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on their behalf*, with Authorized Users permitted — covering both the affiliate and contractor elements.
- **§ 13.2** makes paid-up/embedded software and Vendor Technology licences *perpetual, irrevocable*, royalty-free and fully paid for Customer and its Affiliates.
- **§ 13.3** limits Vendor revocation/suspension to a material uncured payment or use breach after notice and cure, and permits transfer of licence rights to an Affiliate or successor; **§ 24.1** confirms Customer may assign without Vendor's consent to an Affiliate or M&A successor, so the successor-transfer element is unconditioned.
- **§ 13.4** restrictions are narrow and expressly preserve authorized security testing and use of Customer Data and output; no at-will revocability or affiliate notice-gating exists.
